title: Operator might be unable to withdraw rewards due to gas limit
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as operator's yield will be frozen  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires operator to be a special multi-sig wallet or contract  ## Description  The `PoolGovernance:withdrawRewards` method allows operators to withdraw their yield, which happens with this external call:  ```solidity (bool sent, ) = msg.sender.call{value: rewards, gas: 2300}(""); ```  The 2300 gas limit might not be enough for smart contract wallets that have a `receive` or `fallback` function that takes more than 2300 gas units, which is too low (you can't do much more than emit an event).
